import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace Topology

theorem connected_preimage_of_closed_connected {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (p : X → Y) (hq : IsQuotientMap p)
    {C : Set Y} (hCclosed : IsClosed C) (hCconn : IsConnected C)
    (hX : ∀ y : Y, IsConnected (p ⁻¹' ({y} : Set Y))) :
    IsConnected (p ⁻¹' C) := by
  have hcoind : IsCoinducing p := hq.isCoinducing
  exact hcoind.isConnected_preimage_of_isClosed hX hCclosed hCconn
